// The spec of the proposer's golden. Every shape in it is one the corpus already proved, put
// together in one file so that the interactions are covered too: two spans on a line, spans
// crossing lines, a tag pair, a tag carrying an attribute string, a label on a tag, a labeled
// span nested inside a tagged region, and a line of punctuation alone.

== golden
1 C <!--| a page comment |-->
2 S "|<!-- text in an attribute|"
4 > (TypeScript) <script
4 S "|text/typescript|"
4 > >
5 C //| a line comment
6-9 C (Markdown optional ts-doc-comment) /**| ... |*/
11 S "|a string|"
12-13 S `| ... |`
16 < </script>
17 > (SCSS) <style
17 S "|scss|"
17 > >
18 C /*| a css comment |*/
19 < </style>
